offence_note: Luring: communicating with person believed under 16 for sexual purpose
sentence_quote: The sentence of fourteen months imprisonment was not otherwise challenged and is affirmed.
note: Crown appeal allowed; 2-month Charter reduction set aside but service of those 2 months stayed.

offence_note: Production of cannabis (320 plants grow operation)
sentence_quote: I am satisfied that a 12-month conditional sentence order to be followed by a period of six months' probation is a fit sentence and I impose that sentence on Mr. Petrie.
note: Joint submission; victim surcharge waived; curfew first six months.

offence_note: Armed robbery of gas station attendant with a knife
sentence_quote: I will impose a term of imprisonment to be served in the community of two years less one day under the terms and conditions set out below
note: House arrest with curfew and electronic monitoring; other order is electronic monitoring condition.

offence_note: Assault offences from home altercation (inferred); brother co-offender
sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted, the sentence of imprisonment reduced to two years, and a prohibition order under s. 100 for a period of ten years substituted.
note: Offence type not stated explicitly; conviction appeal dismissed; sentence reduced for disparity with brother.

offence_note: Second degree murder; indecently interfering with human remains
sentence_quote: I sentence you to life imprisonment and a period of parole ineligibility of 15 years in relation to the count of second-degree murder and a concurrent sentence of five years in relation to the count of interference with human remains.
note: Concurrent five years for interference with remains.

offence_note: Robbery as driver; party to home robbery
sentence_quote: the sentence imposed following plea is set aside and a sentence of six months incarceration less a day is substituted, which has now been served.
note: Reduced from one year; immigration consequences and parity with co-accused. Co-accused not before the court.

offence_note: Criminal breach of trust by lawyer; trust funds converted
sentence_quote: a conditional sentence of two years less a day with house arrest. The court also imposed a condition of 200 hours of community service which was capable of achieving the restorative objective of reparation to the community.
note: Crown appeal dismissed 5-4; Court of Appeal conditional sentence stands. Dissent ignored.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm (summary conviction); brain damage to victim
sentence_quote: The trial judge sentenced the appellant to a term of imprisonment of 12 months.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; leave to appeal sentence refused.

offence_note: Unlawfully in a dwelling house; breach of probation
sentence_quote: The sentence is a totality of two years in a federal institution.
note: Three months remand counted as six months in setting sentence; three months concurrent for breach.

offence_note: Manslaughter in home invasion; concealed weapon; prohibited firearm possession
sentence_quote: I am sentencing you as follows: (1) for the manslaughter count, I am imposing a sentence of eight years' imprisonment; (2) for the count of carrying a concealed weapon, I am imposing a sentence of one-year imprisonment to be served consecutive to the eight-year term
note: Joint submission; 8y manslaughter plus 1y consecutive; 2.5y concurrent to the 1y; victim surcharge waived.
